name: Adafruit KiCad Library
description: Symbols and footprints adapted from Adafruit's hardware library.
description_full: Schematic symbols and footprints mechanically converted from the Adafruit EAGLE Library (adafruit/Adafruit-Eagle-Library) for use in KiCad 8 and later: 666 symbols and 643 footprints. Unofficial community packaging - Adafruit publishes no native KiCad library or PCM feed. The conversion is automated and unreviewed part by part, so verify footprint geometry against the manufacturer drawing before committing a board to fabrication.
